// Positive-control fixture for tests/test_identity_gate.py (Rust).
//
// Line 7 (a locale to_lowercase key) and line 9 (an unmarked lower($1) lookup) MUST be
// flagged; line 11 carries a sanctioned protocol marker and must pass.
fn dedupe(ids: Vec<String>) {
    let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::new();
    for id in ids { seen.insert(id.to_lowercase()); }
    let _q = sqlx::query(
        "SELECT 1 FROM synthetic.arm_overlay WHERE id_lower = lower($1)",
    );
    let _m = "Application/JSON".to_ascii_lowercase(); // IDENTITY-ALLOW[protocol: media type, not an ARM id]
}
